name: Sosyal Donma / Zihin Boşalması
definition: Sosyal ortamda 'aklıma hiçbir şey gelmiyor'. Kaygı çalışma belleğini yiyor; cevap üretmek için gereken zihinsel alan kalmıyor.

mechanisms.primary: Social-evaluative stress impairs working memory → mind blank
mechanisms.brain: dlPFC reduced activation; amygdala increased; IPS-dlPFC connectivity disrupted
secondary: Affective working memory disruption under emotional load (SAD)
Impaired attentional disengagement from threat stimuli
mechanisms.key_finding: Social skills often adequate — can't ACCESS under threat (Alden & Taylor, 2014)

research_sources.finding: Social anxiety + acute stress: independent negative effects on WM updating. Reduced accuracy, increased false alarms.
Social stress impairs PFC, shifts to emotion processing regions. Intrusive thoughts consume attentional resources.
Social threat impairs WM. Widespread PFC/IPS reduction. IPS mediates performance impairment.
Clinical anxiety: reduced dlPFC activation during safety AND threat. Core component, not just acute.
Trait social anxiety: impaired top-down control under WM load. Can't inhibit task-irrelevant distractors.
SAD: WM intact under neutral conditions. Disrupted under emotionally salient/socially evaluative content.
Social anxiety: skills often adequate/strong but can't access under threat. Prefrontal throttled.
Structured exposure: large, durable symptom reductions. Meta-analysis Psychological Medicine.
Repeated exposure: amygdala rCBF reduction. Within-session anxiety decrease from 1st to 2nd speech.
7-day brief imaginal exposure via app: significantly greater SAD reduction vs self-monitoring. More exercises = better outcome.
Graded exposure: systematic approach, ranked difficulty 0-10. Repeat steps until confident. 3-5 reps for anxiety drop.
'I lost my train of thought—what were you saying about [last word]?' Buys time, shows listening.
Act within 3 seconds of considering a comment. Prevents second-guessing before conversation moves on.
Single session exposure effective for social anxiety. Effects remain at 4-week follow-up.
15x20min emotional WM training reduces SAD similarly to internet CBT. Stand-alone potential.

solutions.name: Hazır Scriptler (5 cümle)
solutions.evidence: STRONG — bypasses WM for word retrieval
solutions.protocol: Ezberle: 'Bakıyorum—', 'İlk aklıma gelen şu—', 'Bana 1 saniye ver', 'Kayboldum ne diyordun?', 'Bilmiyorum kontrol edeyim'

solutions.name: Mind-Blank Rescue
solutions.protocol: Donduğunda: 'Kayboldum, ne diyordun [son kelime]?' Zemin geri verir, zaman kazanır.

solutions.name: Dışa Odak (Attention Training)
solutions.protocol: 'Ne düşünüyorlar?' yerine 'Şu an ne oluyor?' Karşındakini dinle, kendini izleme.

solutions.name: Graded Exposure (Mikro)
solutions.protocol: Haftalık korku 3-4/10'dan başla. Günde 1 mikro eylem. 3-5 tekrar → kaygı düşer.

solutions.name: Evde Prova (Rehearsal)
solutions.protocol: Zor konuşmayı evde 10-15 kez sesli tekrarla. Kayıt al, dinle.

solutions.name: 1 Cümle Kuralı
solutions.protocol: Mükemmel cevap arama. Tek cümle yeter. Beyn tek cümleyle açılır.

solutions.name: Ön Konu Hazırlığı (S02)
solutions.evidence: STRONG — reduces encoding demand in moment
solutions.protocol: Sohbete girmeden konuyu 30 sn tara. 1 cümle hazırla.

daily_protocol.during_day: Script kullan; dışa odak; 1 cümle kuralı
daily_protocol.evening: 10 dk evde prova veya exposure değerlendirme

interactions.note: Donma = WM dolu + kaygı. Script ve ön bilgi WM'i boşaltır.
